provenance.encodes: Saudi Official Gazette (Umm al-Qura) convention: Royal Decree No. <M|R|A>/<n> dated <d/m/yyyy>H (Hijri)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Saudi Bureau of Experts (laws.boe.gov.sa) entry for any law and compare the 'Royal Decree No. M/.. dated ..H' line; check the GCC Saudi Arabia chapter of a legal-citation guide.

positive.text: Issued by Royal Decree No. M/51 dated 23/8/1426H.
The Capital Market Law, Royal Decree No. M/30 dated 2/6/1424 H, applies.
Companies Law by Royal Decree No. (R/132) dated 1/12/1443H and Royal Decree A/9.

negative: The Royal Decree was issued yesterday.
A royal decree of the king was read aloud.

note: Hijri year only; no Gregorian conversion. Prefix letter M (royal decree approving a law), R or A also seen. Decree numbers in the first example are illustrative of the syntax; a web search suggested the real decree for M/51 is dated 1433H.
